patterns.note: Sections feature a full-bleed dark background with content often centered or arranged in an asymmetrical two-column layout, using ample negative space to separate elements.
Headings are large, bold, and modern sans-serif, often paired with smaller, uppercase labels for context, creating a strong visual hierarchy against the dark background.
The site employs a high-contrast dark mode theme, primarily using deep blacks and dark greys for backgrounds, paired with crisp white and light grey for all text and iconography.

The hero section features a subtle, dynamic background animation (likely video or WebGL). A highly distinctive scroll-triggered motion involves the entire page content collapsing or transitioning to a minimal, full-screen black display with only 'TGE' centered, after scrolling past the initial content.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections, each introduced by a large, impactful heading, often with a subtle background graphic or texture.

technique_notes: The site utilizes a full-bleed dark aesthetic, where deep black or dark grey backgrounds extend across the entire viewport, providing a sophisticated canvas for light-colored text and graphics.

Typography is managed with a modern sans-serif font, employing significant size and weight variations to distinguish headings from body text and small, uppercase labels. Text is consistently light-colored for contrast against dark backgrounds.

The motion system is driven by GSAP ScrollTrigger, orchestrating scroll-based reveals where content sections likely fade or slide into view as they enter the viewport. The hero section integrates a dynamic background, possibly a video or WebGL animation, to create an immersive initial experience. A prominent interaction involves a dramatic full-screen content transformation or collapse, where the page transitions to a minimal 'TGE' display after a certain scroll depth, likely powered by GSAP and WebGL.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, bold headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, often uppercase labels and legible body text, all in a modern sans-serif.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, creating a sense of grandeur and clarity.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its dramatic scroll-triggered content transformation, where the entire page transitions from rich content to a minimal, full-screen 'TGE' display. This, combined with the sophisticated dark aesthetic and dynamic WebGL/video backgrounds, creates a highly immersive and memorable user experience that goes beyond typical marketing site animations.
